subject: Lighthouse now grades your site for AI agents

points: Chrome's Lighthouse has an experimental Agentic Browsing category that checks whether software can read your pages and complete tasks on them.
The audits are deterministic: llms.txt, WebMCP, accessibility and layout stability. There is no 0 to 100 score yet.
Fix accessible forms and layout shift first. Those help human visitors today, whatever happens to the agent standards.

quickSignals.title: Shopify ships agents.md for every store
quickSignals.summary: Themes can now serve an agents.md file through a Liquid template, so millions of storefronts get an agent-facing entry point by default.

quickSignals.title: llms.txt shows no clear effect on AI citations
quickSignals.summary: An SE Ranking study of 300k domains found no measurable link between having llms.txt and being cited by AI answers.

quickSignals.title: DebugBear breaks down the new Lighthouse category
quickSignals.summary: A walkthrough of each Agentic Browsing audit, with notes on which checks are stable and which depend on draft standards.
